name: VAMA WOVENFAB LIMITED
about: Vama Wovenfab Limited manufactures and sells Polypropylene and High Density Polyethylene woven sack bags, fabrics, and plastic granules. It serves businesses in India. The company offers products woven bags includes Polypropylene (PP) Bags, High-Density Polyethylene (HDPE) Bags, Biaxially Oriented Polypropylene (BOPP) Laminated Bags and Loop Handle Bags; woven fabric includes PP Fabric, HDPE Fabric, Flexible Intermediate Bulk Container (FIBC) Fabric, Polypropylene and High-Density Polyethylene (PP and HDPE) Rolls, HDPE Tarpolean and Coloured Woven Fabric Sheets. It also offer customised bulk packaging solutions. The company was incorporated in 2011 and is based in Mumbai, India with a manufacturing unit in Daman, Gujarat.
